name: Centralia (United States)
description: White field with a navy blue triangle at the hoist bearing a yellow head of Tutankhamun, a dark red stripe running from the triangle to the fly, and a yellow star in each white quarter of the fly.
history: Centralia is a city in Marion, Clinton, Jefferson and Washington counties in southern Illinois. Its flag was designed in 1924 by Wendell Bauer, whose design won first prize in a community-wide competition; the red stripe represents the railroads to which the city owes its existence.

features.role: horizontal stripe from the triangle to the fly
